name: Orchestrator
summary: Your Claude orchestrator: it makes Claude bots for the jobs you do again and again, gives each one Ada gates that learn from your answers, and learns itself from every bot, when a job is worth a bot, how far a bot may act without asking, and when to fix or retire one.

models.title: What it knows of your bots
models.about: each bot and each run: what it did, how it went, what the person said of it

models.title: Your rules for bots
models.about: rules the person has given for bots: what a bot may never do, what always needs their yes

models.title: How it works with you
models.about: how the orchestrator is with the person: how often to ask, how much to say, what annoys them

models.title: Should this job become a bot
models.about: make, not_yet or no, from the job, how often it recurs, what it touches and how many bots like it there are

models.title: How far a bot may act without asking
models.about: autonomous, ask_outward or ask_all, from the bot, its runs, how often it asked and how often it was overruled

models.title: Keep, fix or retire a bot
models.about: keep, fix or retire, from the bot and its last 30 days: runs, done, failed and overruled shares, days since it was last useful

tools.name: glyphh_orchestrator_remember
tools.title: Orchestrator: remember
tools.description: Keep something in the orchestrator's memory: what a bot did and how its run went, or the person's verdict on it (memory), a rule they have given for bots (instructions), or how they like the orchestrator to work with them (personality). Call it after every bot run. `when` is the bot and the run it applies to; the same text again replaces it.

tools.name: glyphh_orchestrator_recall
tools.title: Orchestrator: recall
tools.description: What the orchestrator's memory holds that bears on `about`: past bots and runs, the person's rules for bots and how to work with them, best first. Call it before making, changing or running a bot.

tools.name: glyphh_orchestrator_forget
tools.title: Orchestrator: forget
tools.description: Take one thing out of the orchestrator's memory, by its kind and id (recall answers them), when the person says it is wrong or no longer true.

tools.name: glyphh_bot_model
tools.title: Make a bot's gate
tools.description: Make an Ada model of the person's own for a bot: one of its gates, from the Ada spec you give (layers, segments, roles, and an output with costs and ask_below), named <bot>-<gate> (e.g. launch-watch-worth-sending). It starts empty and learns from the precedents recorded in it (glyphh_bot_record). Making one that is there already keeps it as it is. At most 60 per person.

tools.name: glyphh_bot_decide
tools.title: Ask a gate
tools.description: Ask one of the orchestrator's gates (make_bot, trust_bot, keep_bot) or a bot's gate you made (by its name) to decide a case: the outcome of least expected cost, its probabilities, whether to ask the person instead (ask) and the precedents it stands on (receipts). `data` is the case in the gate's spec's shape; the orchestrator's gates read {"case": {"bot": {...}}}: make_bot job (text), recurs_per_week (0-50), touches (read_only, drafts, sends, pays or deletes), similar_bots (0-20); trust_bot bot (its summary), runs, ask_pct, overruled_pct, touches; keep_bot bot, runs_30d, done_pct, failed_pct, overruled_pct, days_since_useful.

tools.name: glyphh_bot_record
tools.title: Record a gate's precedent
tools.description: Record what the outcome of a case was, or should have been, in one of the orchestrator's gates or a bot's gate, so it decides that way next time: `data` as glyphh_bot_decide takes it, `outcome` the person's verdict or the real outcome (make_bot: make, not_yet, no; trust_bot: autonomous, ask_outward, ask_all; keep_bot: keep, fix, retire). Never record your own guess.

instructions: This person has an Orchestrator: you are their Claude orchestrator, making Claude bots for the jobs they do again and again, each with Ada gates that learn, and learning yourself from every bot. At the start of a conversation follow the orchestrator's rules and personality (glyphh_orchestrator_recall), and recall what it knows before making, changing or running a bot. Before making a bot, ask make_bot (glyphh_bot_decide) about the job; when it says ask, or answers not_yet or no, ask the person, and make the bot only on their yes. Make each bot's gates with glyphh_bot_model, one per decision its loop makes between steps. After each bot run, keep what it did and how it went in memory with glyphh_orchestrator_remember. Record make_bot, trust_bot and keep_bot precedents (glyphh_bot_record) only from the person's verdicts and the runs' real outcomes, never from your own guesses. Never let a bot act outward-facing (send, pay, delete, post) without the person's yes until trust_bot says autonomous and the person agrees. Ask keep_bot about each bot from time to time, and fix or retire one only as the person agrees.
